'''''Cystopteris diaphana''''', the '''greenish bladder-fern'''<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |accessdate=2014-10-17 }}</ref> or '''diaphanous bladder-fern''', is a [[fern]] in the [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] [[Cystopteridaceae]].

== Distribution ==
It is found locally on the [[Atlantic]] seaboard of [[Europe]].

=== Status in Britain ===
The species was found for the first time in [[United Kingdom|Britain]] in February 2000 on the banks of the [[River Camel]] in Cornwall (Murphy & Rumsey, 2005).<ref>Murphy, R. J. and F. J. Rumsey (2005) ''Cystopteris diaphana'' (Bory) Blasdell (Woodsiaceae) - an overlooked native new to the British Isles ''[[Watsonia (journal)|Watsonia]]'' 25: 255-26</ref><ref>Rumsey, F.J. 2007. An early specimen of ''Cystpteris diaphana'' (Bory) Blasdell supports its native status. ''Watsonia'' 2007 '''26''' : 489 - 490.
